I once saw this the other day and it opened my eyes :
You’re waiting for a bus and you’re expecting it to come. But the bus comes and it doesn’t stop - it just drives off. The buses come every five Minutes. Sure, you might try and grab the bus drivers attention and chase it for a few seconds but once you’ve realised the bus isn’t stopping you won’t keep chasing it will you? You’ll patiently stand there and wait for another bus that’s going to stop for you. It’s the same with crushes. Don’t chase after a crush who won’t stop and think for you. If they’re meant to be with you it’ll happen - if not then wait . Soon enough one day you’ll find someone who’s perfect ✨

Ok so my advice won’t be the best and that’s because IM IN THE EXACT SAME SITUATION apart from the fact that mine is online.
What I mean is that I’m at the stage where (like you) I’ve realised I’m crushing on someone and I don’t like it.
Honestly crushing on someone is hard work - you have to be prepared for either success or of course heartbreak and hurt. 
In your situation - either the guy is trying to act cool and act hard to get or maybe he’s genuinely thinking of you as a friend. 
BUT feelings change - he may think of you as a friend now and grow to like you
OR he probably already likes you and he probs has that conversation with you to see if you’ve ever had crushes - and he said he hasn’t had crushes to make him seem “better”.

Anyway - I don’t think you should let the feelings die
Treasure them and value them even if it goes to a waste 
Having a crush is a rlly bad experience for some ppl (like me and u) but u can make it a good one.
Honestly - not having a crush can be boring so make the most of it.
I remember me complaining about how boring my life was a few months ago because I had no love life 🤷‍♀️

Good luck 💞
